-- models/200-silver/dim_date.sql
-- Layer: Silver  |  Materialization: Table
-- Pattern: Static calendar dimension (no SCD needed)
--
-- Covers 2022-01-01 → 2025-12-31
-- Fiscal year starts January 1 (standard in Spain).
-- Includes business day flag, Spanish weekday/month names,
-- ISO week, and quarterly groupings.

with date_spine as (

    select unnest(
        generate_series(
            cast('2022-01-01' as date),
            cast('2025-12-31' as date),
            interval '1 day'
        )
    ) as date_day

),

final as (

    select
        -- PK: integer key YYYYMMDD
        cast(strftime(date_day, '%Y%m%d') as integer)           as date_key,
        cast(date_day as date)                                   as date_day,

        -- Calendar decomposition
        year(date_day)                                           as year,
        quarter(date_day)                                        as quarter_number,
        'Q' || quarter(date_day)                                 as quarter_label,
        month(date_day)                                          as month_number,
        strftime(date_day, '%B')                                 as month_name_en,

        case month(date_day)
            when  1 then 'Enero'
            when  2 then 'Febrero'
            when  3 then 'Marzo'
            when  4 then 'Abril'
            when  5 then 'Mayo'
            when  6 then 'Junio'
            when  7 then 'Julio'
            when  8 then 'Agosto'
            when  9 then 'Septiembre'
            when 10 then 'Octubre'
            when 11 then 'Noviembre'
            when 12 then 'Diciembre'
        end                                                      as month_name_es,

        -- ISO week
        isoyear(date_day)                                        as iso_year,
        week(date_day)                                           as week_number,

        -- Day
        dayofmonth(date_day)                                     as day_of_month,
        dayofweek(date_day)                                      as day_of_week,    -- 0=Sun
        dayofyear(date_day)                                      as day_of_year,

        strftime(date_day, '%A')                                 as weekday_name_en,
        case dayofweek(date_day)
            when 0 then 'Domingo'
            when 1 then 'Lunes'
            when 2 then 'Martes'
            when 3 then 'Miércoles'
            when 4 then 'Jueves'
            when 5 then 'Viernes'
            when 6 then 'Sábado'
        end                                                      as weekday_name_es,

        -- Business day flag (Mon–Fri, national holiday logic excluded)
        case when dayofweek(date_day) in (0, 6) then false
             else true
        end                                                      as is_business_day,

        case when dayofweek(date_day) in (0, 6) then 'Fin de Semana'
             else 'Día Hábil'
        end                                                      as day_type,

        -- Fiscal year — January start (Spain standard)
        year(date_day)                                           as fiscal_year,

        case quarter(date_day)
            when 1 then 'FQ1'
            when 2 then 'FQ2'
            when 3 then 'FQ3'
            when 4 then 'FQ4'
        end                                                      as fiscal_quarter,

        -- Convenience labels
        cast(strftime(date_day, '%Y-%m') as varchar)             as year_month,
        cast(strftime(date_day, '%Y-W%V') as varchar)            as year_week

    from date_spine

)

select * from final
order by date_day

-- models/200-silver/dim_product.sql
-- Layer: Silver  |  Materialization: Table
-- Pattern: SCD Type 2
--
-- Tracks product attribute changes (interest rates, fees, active status).
-- Two snapshots are simulated: original rates (2022-01-01) and a rate
-- revision (2023-07-01), demonstrating the SCD2 pattern.

with products as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_bronze"."stg_products"

),

-- Two version snapshots per product
product_versions as (

    -- Version 1: original rates at launch
    select
        product_id,
        product_name,
        product_category,
        interest_rate_pct,
        fee_rate_pct,
        is_active,
        cast('2022-01-01' as date)          as valid_from,
        1                                   as version_number
    from products

    union all

    -- Version 2: rate revision mid-2023
    select
        product_id,
        product_name,
        product_category,
        round(interest_rate_pct * 1.10, 4)  as interest_rate_pct,
        round(fee_rate_pct      * 0.95, 4)  as fee_rate_pct,
        is_active,
        cast('2023-07-01' as date)          as valid_from,
        2                                   as version_number
    from products

),

versioned as (

    select
        product_id,
        product_name,
        product_category,
        interest_rate_pct,
        fee_rate_pct,
        is_active,
        valid_from,
        version_number,

        lead(valid_from) over (
            partition by product_id
            order by valid_from
        ) - interval '1 day'               as valid_to,

        case
            when lead(valid_from) over (
                partition by product_id
                order by valid_from
            ) is null then true
            else false
        end                                 as is_current

    from product_versions

),

final as (

    select
        md5(product_id || '-' || cast(valid_from as varchar)) as product_key,
        product_id,
        product_name,
        product_category,
        interest_rate_pct,
        fee_rate_pct,
        is_active,
        version_number,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        is_current,
        current_timestamp                   as _updated_at

    from versioned

)

select * from final

-- models/silver/dim_account.sql
-- Layer: Silver  |  Materialization: Table
-- Pattern: SCD Type 2
--
-- Tracks historical changes to account attributes (segment, risk_level).
-- Each row represents one VERSION of an account.
-- A single account can have multiple rows with non-overlapping validity ranges.
--
-- Key columns:
--   account_key   → surrogate key (PK)
--   account_id    → natural/business key (from source)
--   valid_from    → date this version became active
--   valid_to      → date this version was superseded (NULL = current)
--   is_current    → boolean flag for easy filtering

with accounts as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_bronze"."stg_accounts"

),

changes as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_bronze"."stg_account_changes"

),

-- Build one row per (account_id, effective_date) combining
-- the original record + any subsequent changes
account_versions as (

    -- Version 0: original record at open_date
    select
        account_id,
        customer_name,
        email,
        phone,
        branch,
        segment                             as segment,
        risk_level                          as risk_level,
        product_id,
        open_date,
        status,
        credit_limit,
        open_date                           as valid_from,
        1                                   as version_number

    from accounts

    union all

    -- Version N: each subsequent change event
    select
        a.account_id,
        a.customer_name,
        a.email,
        a.phone,
        a.branch,
        c.new_segment                       as segment,
        c.new_risk_level                    as risk_level,
        a.product_id,
        a.open_date,
        a.status,
        a.credit_limit,
        c.change_date                       as valid_from,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.account_id
            order by c.change_date
        ) + 1                               as version_number

    from accounts a
    inner join changes c
        on a.account_id = c.account_id

),

-- Assign valid_to = the next version's valid_from - 1 day
versioned as (

    select
        account_id,
        customer_name,
        email,
        phone,
        branch,
        segment,
        risk_level,
        product_id,
        open_date,
        status,
        credit_limit,
        valid_from,
        version_number,

        -- valid_to: start of the next version, or NULL if current
        lead(valid_from) over (
            partition by account_id
            order by valid_from
        ) - interval '1 day'               as valid_to,

        -- is_current: true only for the latest version
        case
            when lead(valid_from) over (
                partition by account_id
                order by valid_from
            ) is null then true
            else false
        end                                 as is_current

    from account_versions

),

-- Surrogate key using md5 hash of natural key + version
final as (

    select
        md5(account_id || '-' || cast(valid_from as varchar)) as account_key,
        account_id,
        customer_name,
        email,
        phone,
        branch,
        segment,
        risk_level,
        product_id,
        open_date,
        status,
        credit_limit,
        version_number,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        is_current,
        current_timestamp                   as _updated_at

    from versioned

)

select * from final

-- models/gold/fact_transactions.sql
-- Layer: Gold  |  Materialization: Table
-- Pattern: Star Schema Fact Table (Transaction Grain)
--
-- One row per financial transaction.
-- Joins to dimensions using the versioned surrogate keys (SCD Type 2 aware):
--   dim_account  → account version active ON the transaction date
--   dim_product  → product version active ON the transaction date
--   dim_date     → calendar dimension
--
-- This is the core fact table. All KPI marts derive from here.

with txns as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_bronze"."stg_transactions"

),

-- Resolve account version active on the transaction date (SCD2 join)
dim_account as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_silver"."dim_account"

),

-- Resolve product version active on the transaction date (SCD2 join)
dim_product as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_silver"."dim_product"

),

dim_date as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_silver"."dim_date"

),

-- Join accounts: get the account_key for the version valid at txn date
txns_with_account as (

    select
        t.*,
        a.account_key,
        a.segment                   as account_segment,
        a.risk_level                as account_risk_level,
        a.branch                    as account_branch,
        a.product_id                as account_product_id

    from txns t
    left join dim_account a
        on  t.account_id    = a.account_id
        and t.transaction_date >= a.valid_from
        and (t.transaction_date <= a.valid_to or a.valid_to is null)

),

-- Join products on the account's product for the valid rate at txn date
txns_with_product as (

    select
        ta.*,
        p.product_key,
        p.product_name,
        p.product_category,
        p.interest_rate_pct,
        p.fee_rate_pct          as product_fee_rate_pct

    from txns_with_account ta
    left join dim_product p
        on  ta.account_product_id   = p.product_id
        and ta.transaction_date    >= p.valid_from
        and (ta.transaction_date   <= p.valid_to or p.valid_to is null)

),

-- Join date dimension
final as (

    select
        -- Surrogate fact key
        md5(tp.transaction_id)              as transaction_key,

        -- Foreign keys
        tp.account_key,
        tp.product_key,
        d.date_key,

        -- Degenerate dimensions (attributes of the transaction itself)
        tp.transaction_id,
        tp.account_id,
        tp.transaction_type,
        tp.direction,
        tp.currency,
        tp.channel,
        tp.status,

        -- Additive measures
        tp.amount,
        tp.fee_amount,
        tp.net_amount,
        tp.exchange_rate,

        -- Derived measures
        case tp.direction
            when 'Crédito' then tp.net_amount
            else 0.0
        end                                 as credit_amount,

        case tp.direction
            when 'Débito'  then tp.net_amount
            else 0.0
        end                                 as debit_amount,

        -- Contextual attributes (avoid joins downstream)
        tp.account_segment,
        tp.account_risk_level,
        tp.account_branch,
        tp.product_name,
        tp.product_category,
        d.year,
        d.quarter_label,
        d.month_number,
        d.month_name_es,
        d.is_business_day,
        d.fiscal_year,
        d.fiscal_quarter,

        tp.transaction_date,
        tp._loaded_at

    from txns_with_product tp
    left join dim_date d
        on tp.transaction_date = d.date_day

    -- Only completed transactions for financial reporting
    where tp.status = 'Completada'

)

select * from final

-- models/gold/mart_kpis.sql
-- Layer: Gold  |  Materialization: Table
-- Grain: one row per (year, month, segment, product_category)
--
-- Business KPIs ready for BI consumption.
-- Derived entirely from fact_transactions — no raw source access.

with fact as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_gold"."fact_transactions"

),

monthly_agg as (

    select
        year,
        month_number,
        month_name_es,
        quarter_label,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_quarter,
        account_segment,
        account_branch,
        product_category,

        -- Volume KPIs
        count(*)                                    as total_transactions,
        count(distinct account_id)                  as active_accounts,

        -- Revenue KPIs
        sum(credit_amount)                          as total_credits,
        sum(debit_amount)                           as total_debits,
        sum(fee_amount)                             as total_fees_collected,
        sum(net_amount)                             as net_flow,

        -- Averages
        avg(amount)                                 as avg_transaction_amount,
        avg(fee_amount)                             as avg_fee_amount,

        -- Channel mix
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'App Móvil')    as txns_app,
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'Web')          as txns_web,
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'ATM')          as txns_atm,
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'Sucursal')     as txns_branch,
        count(*) filter (where channel = 'Homebanking')  as txns_homebanking,

        -- Risk distribution
        count(*) filter (where account_risk_level = 'Bajo')   as txns_risk_low,
        count(*) filter (where account_risk_level = 'Medio')  as txns_risk_medium,
        count(*) filter (where account_risk_level = 'Alto')   as txns_risk_high,

        -- Currency breakdown
        sum(amount) filter (where currency = 'ARS')     as amount_ars,
        sum(amount) filter (where currency = 'USD')     as amount_usd,
        sum(amount) filter (where currency = 'EUR')     as amount_eur

    from fact
    group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9

)

select
    *,
    -- Derived ratios
    round(total_fees_collected / nullif(total_credits, 0) * 100, 4) as fee_rate_pct,
    round(txns_app::float / nullif(total_transactions, 0) * 100, 2) as digital_pct

from monthly_agg
order by year, month_number, account_segment

-- models/300-gold/vw_dashboard.sql
-- Layer: Gold  |  Materialization: Table
-- Purpose: Pre-aggregated flat view optimized for Evidence.dev dashboard.
--          One row per calendar month — zero joins needed downstream.

with kpis as (

    select * from "finanzas_dw"."main_gold"."mart_kpis"

),

monthly_totals as (

    select
        year,
        month_number,
        month_name_es,
        quarter_label,
        fiscal_year,
        fiscal_quarter,
        sum(total_transactions)             as total_transactions,
        sum(active_accounts)                as active_accounts,
        sum(total_credits)                  as total_credits,
        sum(total_debits)                   as total_debits,
        sum(total_fees_collected)           as total_fees,
        sum(net_flow)                       as net_flow,
        avg(avg_transaction_amount)         as avg_txn_amount,
        sum(txns_app)                       as txns_digital,
        round(
            sum(txns_app)::float /
            nullif(sum(total_transactions), 0) * 100, 2
        )                                   as digital_adoption_pct

    from kpis
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6

)

select
    year,
    month_number,
    month_name_es,
    quarter_label,
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_quarter,

    year || '-' || lpad(cast(month_number as varchar), 2, '0') as year_month,

    total_transactions,
    active_accounts,
    round(total_credits,   2)               as total_credits,
    round(total_debits,    2)               as total_debits,
    round(total_fees,      2)               as total_fees,
    round(net_flow,        2)               as net_flow,
    round(avg_txn_amount,  2)               as avg_txn_amount,
    digital_adoption_pct

from monthly_totals
order by year, month_number
